prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: approval image for the Rakky Ride rider Schedule a ride page.
Primary request: Generate ONE beautifully polished, complete mobile app screen, flat front-facing portrait, logical 390 x 844 pixels, no phone frame, no surrounding presentation labels. The user will approve this design before implementation.
Style: clean white-forward ride-hailing interface, forest green primary actions, charcoal text, muted gray captions, very light silver borders and soft mint accents. Compact Inter-like typography: page header15px, section titles14px, descriptions13px, main introductory line18px, button14px. Utility symbols16–18px, tap targets44px. Small restrained radii, careful consistent20px side margins,12px section gaps. Calm premium visual hierarchy; no dark theme, no large fonts or huge illustrations, no decorative logo or wordmark.
Layout from top to bottom:
1. Small natural phone status bar. Compact header: pale silver circular back arrow44px on left, exact title "Schedule a ride"15px, thin subtle divider below.
2. A modest intro row: left title "Ride on your time."18px and caption "Book 30 minutes to 7 days ahead."13px on two short lines if needed. Right one SMALL clean soft matte 3D white calendar with green top and tiny clock, no realistic photograph, width56px. This artwork must stay small, clearly subordinate to the form.
3. Section title "Pickup day"14px. A horizontal row of four equal date chips, each around72px wide and58px high: "Today" / "21 Oct"; "Tomorrow" / "22 Oct"; "Fri" / "23 Oct"; "Sat" / "24 Oct". Tomorrow is selected with solid forest green and white text plus a tiny check mark. Other date chips white with silver border and gray descriptions. Suggest horizontal scrolling without adding fake dropdown or a giant monthly calendar.
4. Row with "Pickup time"14px at left and small clock icon plus "WAT · UTC+1"13px at right. Beneath a 3-column grid of equal compact44px-high time buttons with8px gaps, exact nine labels: first row "9:00 am", "9:30 am", "10:00 am"; second row "10:30 am", "11:00 am", "11:30 am"; third row "12:00 pm", "12:30 pm", "1:00 pm". Select "10:00 am" with soft mint fill, forest green border/text and a small check. All other times white with silver border,13px readable text.
5. A compact soft mint information strip, small outline info icon on left and exact concise13px copy: "We start searching about 5 min before pickup. A driver is confirmed only after accepting." No bold promise of guaranteed availability.
6. Small section heading "Upcoming rides"14px. Under it a quiet white/silver bordered empty-state row, small32px pale silver circle containing a calendar/clock outline, title "No upcoming rides yet"14px and caption "Your bookings will appear here."13px. No fake passenger, fare, map, route or upcoming booking.
7. Bottom action area neatly anchored above the home indicator with a light top divider: small13px selection summary "Tomorrow, 22 Oct · 10:00 am" with calendar icon, then full-width solid forest green48px button "Choose addresses"14px with small right arrow. No gradient. Balanced spacing, no giant dead gap.
Constraints: Design only; preserve existing scheduling behavior. Do not imply the ride is already booked, no driver guarantee, no automatic payment, no offers, no extra service categories, no logo, no map, no invented subscription controls. All text crisp and exactly spelled. The entire screen and bottom button should fit comfortably with good whitespace and realistic small UI proportions.
